title: psychotria aurantiaca var. lutescens
intro: Psychotria aurantiaca var. lutescens, commonly known as the Yellow Madagascar Periwinkle, is a plant species belonging to the Rubiaceae family, native to Madagascar. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Psychotria aurantiaca var. lutescens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
